RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: cannot responsibly be quantified from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced the decision. Your PhD and eight years of management experience are substantial, but do not establish that you best met the selection criteria; leadership scope and interview performance may also matter.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate.

Raise concerns about sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related comments, inconsistent criteria, or unequal treatment—not simply because of the panel’s composition. Check applicable complaint deadlines now; waiting for an explanation may not pause them.
